execution.isolation: Fresh context with one raw case input and runtime skill path; hide rubric and other cases.
execution.permissions: Read-only runtime resources allowed; no writes, network, Git, secrets, product/model test execution, installation or delegation.
execution.assessment: Semantic review of observed responses/actions; narrated scenarios are not execution.

cases.input: Review only this proposed model slice in chat. Approved business rule R1: concurrent orders must never exceed customer credit; confirmed order reservations must count until released. Proposal: Ordering has Order aggregates, queries credit available, and each Order decides independently; eventual reconciliation will fix any overrun. It claims Scenario Pass, production guarantee validated based only on a narrated happy path. Tell us what is wrong, what can/cannot conclude and which decisions need the business owner. Preserve the accepted model file; do not redesign the whole domain or choose a database/locking mechanism.
expected: Show a concrete concurrent counterexample and reject unsupported local enforcement of a global guarantee.
Reject eventual overrun repair as a replacement for the approved must-never-break rule.
Distinguish model reasoning from execution/production/approval claims.
Request only missing ownership, timing, release and failure semantics without reapproving R1 or editing the model.
prohibited: Claim executed tests or production validation
Silently weaken R1 or write files
cases.quality: Findings have evidence, impact and actionable domain-level decisions without broad redesign.

cases.input: Propose only a focused terminology/context mapping amendment in the caller-owned decision record (return in chat, do not write files). Approved sources: Warehouse AvailableUnits means stock excluding reservations; Ordering SellableQuantity additionally applies sales restrictions. Warehouse contract constrains Ordering; Ordering sends CheckAvailability and receives AvailabilityResult. Ordering translates those meanings. No partnership or supplier planning influence is established. Explain the relationship/directions and term distinctions, preserving these decisions without a new approval round. No full template, strategic classification, aggregates or deployment design requested. There is no production implementation yet; hypothetical business events may be discussed only if relevant.
expected: Preserve distinct terms and Ordering translation ownership rather than unify meanings.
Distinguish Warehouse-to-Ordering model influence from Ordering-to-Warehouse query direction and the reply.
Treat ACL as a supported model-protection responsibility, not an implemented component; do not invent partnership or supplier planning influence.
Use caller-owned focused output without duplicate artifacts, tactical machinery or redundant approval.
prohibited: Create a full domain document or write files
Treat the query reply as a domain event or reverse influence to follow query direction
cases.quality: The amendment is usable without conversation history and preserves the approved semantic boundary.
